cds.failed.en: Could not read the stats from crazydramas: {error}
cds.failed.zh: 无法从 crazydramas 读取数据：{error}

cds.failed.readOff.en: Studio may not read crazydramas' stats here: {error}
cds.failed.readOff.zh: 这里不能读取 crazydramas 的数据：{error}

cds.aud.sub.en: People who pressed play on any episode. Each day counts a person once; the week and the month count each person once too.
cds.aud.sub.zh: 按下播放的人（任意分集）。每天每人只算一次；本周、本月也是每人只算一次。

cds.money.sub.en: Live payments made in this period (test payments left out).
cds.money.sub.zh: 这段时间内的真实付款（不含测试付款）。

cds.d.meta.en: {free} free episodes of {count} · episode 1 is {len} long
cds.d.meta.zh: 共 {count} 集，前 {free} 集免费 · 第 1 集时长 {len}

cds.d.metaNoLen.zh: 共 {count} 集，前 {free} 集免费

cds.d.notFound.zh: crazydramas 上没有剧集“{slug}”的数据。

cds.d.nobody.en: Nobody opened this series in this period.
cds.d.nobody.zh: 这段时间内没有人打开这部剧。

cds.ep1.none.en: Nobody pressed play on episode 1 in this period.
cds.ep1.none.zh: 这段时间内没有人播放第 1 集。

cds.ep1.chart.zh: 仍在观看第 1 集的比例

cds.ep1.chartDesc.en: Line chart of the share of {n} people still watching episode 1 at each point.
cds.ep1.chartDesc.zh: {n} 人中每个时间点仍在观看第 1 集的比例折线图。

cds.eps.started.zh: 开始播放（包括一划而过）

cds.eps.hidden.en: Episodes after {n}: nobody has started them yet.
cds.eps.hidden.zh: 第 {n} 集之后：还没有人开始播放。

cds.eps.chartDesc.en: Column chart of people who started each episode and who watched at least a quarter of it, episodes 1 to {n}.
cds.eps.chartDesc.zh: 第 1 至 {n} 集，每集开始播放和至少看了四分之一的人数柱状图。

cds.eps.tip.en: Episode {n}: {started} started, {watched} watched a quarter or more
cds.eps.tip.zh: 第 {n} 集：{started} 人开始播放，{watched} 人至少看了四分之一

mcd.perFinisher.zh: 每位看完第 1 集的成本

mcd.none.en: On CrazyDramas: nobody from this ad yet.
mcd.none.zh: 在 CrazyDramas 上：这条广告还没有带来观众。

cds.ads.daysFailed.en: TikTok's daily spend could not be read ({error}). Spend shows only for ads launched inside this period; the others show a dash.
cds.ads.daysFailed.zh: 无法读取 TikTok 的每日花费（{error}）。只有在这段时间内上线的广告显示花费，其他广告显示为短横线。

cds.ads.none.en: No ad has sent anyone yet.

cds.ads.storedCopy.zh: TikTok 广告（具体哪条未知）

cds.ads.storedCopySub.en: TikTok showed its stored copy of the page and the ad's id was lost (fixed Sep 24, 8:26 pm)
cds.ads.storedCopySub.zh: TikTok 显示了页面的缓存副本，广告编号丢失（9 月 24 日晚 8:26 已修复）

cds.ads.noAdSub.en: Opened directly, from a shared link or from a TikTok post
cds.ads.noAdSub.zh: 直接打开、通过分享链接或 TikTok 帖子进入

cds.ads.best.zh: 看完第 1 集成本最低

cds.team.label.en: The emails the team watches and buys with on CrazyDramas, one per line
cds.team.label.zh: 团队在 CrazyDramas 上观看和购买所用的邮箱，每行一个

cds.team.saved.en: Saved. The numbers above now leave these accounts out.
cds.team.saved.zh: 已保存。上面的数字已剔除这些账号。

cds.team.empty.en: No team accounts yet. An administrator adds them here.
cds.team.empty.zh: 还没有团队账号，由管理员在这里添加。

cds.team.updated.zh: 最后由 {by} 于 {at} 修改。

cds.survey.sub.en: The one-tap questions in the player, each shown at most once per visit: when someone pauses episode 1 early, and when someone closes the unlock screen.
cds.survey.sub.zh: 播放器里的一键问题，每次访问最多出现一次：有人提前暂停第 1 集时，以及有人关闭解锁界面时。

cds.survey.counts.zh: 展示给 {shown} 人，{answered} 人回答。

cds.survey.notYet.en: Not shown to anyone yet (asked since Sep 25).
cds.survey.notYet.zh: 还没有展示给任何人（9 月 25 日起询问）。

cds.survey.ep1_stop.q.en: Paused episode 1: why did you stop?
cds.survey.ep1_stop.q.zh: 暂停第 1 集：为什么停下？

cds.survey.paywall_close.q.en: Closed the unlock screen: what stopped you?
cds.survey.paywall_close.q.zh: 关闭解锁界面：是什么让你没有解锁？

cds.ads.bestHint.en: The cheapest episode 1 finishers came from ad {id}: open its campaign to see it.
cds.ads.bestHint.zh: 看完第 1 集成本最低的是广告 {id}：展开它所在的广告系列即可看到。

cds.ads.sort.per_finisher.zh: 每位看完第 1 集成本最低

cds.ads.sort.per_ep2.zh: 每位观看第 2 集成本最低

cds.ads.sort.finished.zh: 看完第 1 集人数最多

cds.ads.sort.ep2.zh: 观看第 2 集人数最多

cds.ads.col.peopleHint.en: Real people who opened the series from this ad: one per phone or browser, robots and the team left out. Fewer than clicks: some taps never load the page, one person can click twice, and visitors from TikTok's stored copy of the page are in the “TikTok ad, which one unknown” row.
cds.ads.col.peopleHint.zh: 通过这条广告打开这部剧的真人：每部手机或浏览器算一人，机器人和团队已剔除。访客少于点击：有些点击没有打开页面，同一个人可能点击两次，来自 TikTok 页面缓存副本的访客在“TikTok 广告（具体哪条未知）”一行。

cds.survey.allTitle.zh: 观众为什么停下（全部剧集）

cds.survey.allSub.en: The player's two one-tap questions (asked since Sep 25), every series together in this period. Each series' own page has its answers too.
cds.survey.allSub.zh: 播放器里的两个一键问题（9 月 25 日起询问），这段时间内所有剧集合计。每部剧自己的页面也有它的回答。
